title: UNHINGED: Ilhan Omar Melts Down on CNN, Calls Trump 'Disturbingly Delusional' as Mass Deportations Begin | Next News Network
text:
Rep. Ilhan Omar (D-MN) suffered a complete meltdown on CNN Wednesday, launching into an unhinged rant calling President Donald Trump "disturbingly delusional" as his administration begins implementing the mass deportation agenda that Americans overwhelmingly voted for in November.
The radical congresswoman's latest outburst came during an appearance on "The Lead," where she desperately tried to attack Trump's immigration enforcement policies. But Americans aren't buying what Omar is selling anymore – they want our laws enforced and our borders secured.
Social media users immediately called out Omar's inflammatory rhetoric. Nick Leavitt tweeted, "Ilhan Omar criticized ICE on CNN after the Minneapolis shooting, with critics saying her rhetoric fuels anger and escalates tensions rather than calming them."
This is rich coming from a woman who has consistently downplayed the September 11th attacks, calling them "some people did something," and has spent years undermining American interests while pushing her radical anti-American agenda in Congress.
"The only thing 'disturbingly delusional' here is Omar thinking she can continue attacking the president that Americans just gave a mandate to secure our border and enforce our immigration laws," one political analyst noted.
The backlash was swift and brutal. Social media user Amy Vazquez shared a video titled "The Exact Moment CNN Host Realizes Ilhan Omar Is a Monster," highlighting how even left-wing media personalities are growing tired of Omar's extremist rhetoric.
Omar's desperate attacks reveal the Democrats' panic as Trump systematically dismantles their open-borders agenda. While she screams about "delusion," Trump is delivering on his promises to the American people who elected him specifically to end the immigration chaos that plagued our nation for four years under Biden.
Patriots across the country are celebrating as Trump's team, led by Immigration Czar Tom Homan and DHS Secretary Kristi Noem, finally puts America First. Meanwhile, Omar and her squad of America-haters can only watch helplessly as their globalist dreams crumble.
The question isn't whether Trump is delusional – it's whether Omar will finally face consequences for her years of anti-American rhetoric and divisive attacks on the country that welcomed her.
